title: HomePNA: Fix FCS calculation when there is no piggybacked payload
description:
When the next Ethertype field 0, that indicates that there is
no payload. (See ITU-T Recs. G.989.2 / G.9954.) In such a
case, rather than calling the ethertype dissector again, use
set_actual_length so that the previously called ethertype dissector
can put the normal eth.trailer field on and, importantly, calculate
the FCS over the entire Ethernet frame including addresses.

Don't set fcs-len to 4 when there is a piggybacked payload for
the same reasons as other tag dissectors that call ethertype a second
type. The FCS might or might not be there; if it is there, we
can't calculate it, so the heuristics are useless. (Note that the
link-layer type mentioned in G.9954 with an extra CRC-16 on the of
the frame would require using separate libpcap link-layer type and
different wiretap encapsulation which is not yet supported - the
frames in issue #15303 are standard ethernet frames, one capture
with FCS and one without.)

This fixes FCS calculation with the HomePNA frames with FCS in
eth-fcs-status-bad-from-profishark.pcapng from #15303.

Also, add a comment about Broadcom reusing the same Ethetype
for entirely different event frames in their Wi-Fi firmwware,
which is what the capture in #12759 actually is.
